articles.title: Chief of Defence Staff launches book on soldier’s personal account, says ‘book will strengthen the roots of Indian Army’
articles.summary: The Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) recently launched a significant book compiling soldiers' personal accounts. The CDS highlighted that such narratives are vital for reinforcing the foundational roots of the Indian Army. This initiative underscores the importance of sharing service experiences, fostering deeper understanding and strengthening the bond within the armed forces, which is crucial for SSB aspirants to appreciate.

articles.title: India, Netherlands navies strengthen maritime cooperation with PASSEX off Kochi
articles.summary: The Indian Navy's INS Sharda conducted a Passage Exercise (PASSEX) with the Royal Netherlands Navy frigate HNLMS De Ruyter off Kochi on May 7. This bilateral naval drill enhances interoperability and maritime cooperation between the two navies. Such exercises are vital for strengthening international defence partnerships and ensuring maritime security, reflecting India's proactive engagement in the Indo-Pacific region.

articles.title: Sarah Ferguson's secret 'friends with benefits' relationship with P. Diddy: It lasted for years, now ANDREW LOWNIE reveals illicit trysts with 'bad boy' rapper that'll have world agog
articles.summary: A significant development unfolded for Andrew and Sarah, involving the Royal Family.
